questions.question: What does chapter 17 anticipate Israel will one day want?
What was the future king commanded not to do?
options: Multiply horses, wives, and gold for himself
Pray and offer sacrifices each morning
Read the law aloud to all the people
Lead all of the people out to battle by his own hand
questions.answer: Multiply horses, wives, and gold for himself

questions.question: The king was to write for himself a copy of the law and read it all his life.
Israel could set a king over them, but only one whom the LORD would _____.
The king was to write a copy of this _____ and read it all his days.
